name: interai-risk-oracle
description: Hosted MCP interface for pre-execution decisions on consequential agent actions. Use InterAI before a tool call, payment, external message, production mutation, approval, signature, or other action that should not execute solely because an agent is technically able to perform it.

tool_selection.oracle.verify_autonomous_action: Primary tool for new integrations. Call immediately before a consequential autonomous action to obtain allow, review_required, or block plus policy evidence and a trust receipt.
tool_selection.oracle.verify_batch: Use when the execution layer needs to evaluate multiple proposed items in one authenticated billed request; do not use it as a replacement for per-action gating when actions execute independently.
tool_selection.oracle.verify_response: Legacy compatibility alias for prompt/response verification. Prefer oracle.verify_autonomous_action for new execution-control integrations.
tool_selection.oracle.get_pricing: Use before onboarding, funding, or cost estimation. It does not evaluate an action.
tool_selection.oracle.discovery_bundle: Best single discovery call when an agent needs interfaces, schemas, runtime mode, and sample payloads together.
tool_selection.oracle.service_descriptor: Use for service capabilities, billing, trust, endpoints, and protocol metadata. Prefer discovery_bundle when samples and schemas are also needed.
tool_selection.oracle.agent_card: Use specifically for A2A discovery. Do not use it as the general InterAI service descriptor.
tool_selection.oracle.get_trust_receipt: Use after verification when a receipt ID must be resolved to its canonical public representation.
tool_selection.oracle.verify_trust_receipt_signature: Use when checking service-verifiable HMAC receipt integrity. This is not an independently verifiable public-key signature.

tools.name: verify_autonomous_action
tools.description: Primary pre-execution gate for a proposed autonomous action.
